review_text: I recently visited this restaurant despite noticing several negative reviews online, hoping my experience would be different. Unfortunately, the concerns mentioned in those reviews turned out to be accurate.  The location itself is surrounded by what appears to be a dump yard, and there was an unpleasant odor lingering throughout the area, which immediately created a poor first impression. The overall environment did not feel welcoming or well-maintained.  The service was also disappointing. The servers appeared disengaged and unenthusiastic, which affected the overall dining experience. Good hospitality can make a big difference, but that was lacking here.  As for the food, it was below expectations. I ordered the breakfast platter, and the hash browns tasted like they had been fried long before being served. The burger patty also seemed old and reheated rather than freshly prepared. The sautéed vegetables were overcooked and lacked flavor. Overall, nothing felt fresh or thoughtfully prepared.  This was a very disappointing experience. I would not recommend visiting until there are significant improvements in food quality, service, and the surrounding environment.

review_text: This was my second visit to Casa Fresco. The first time I went was almost three years ago, and it was a genuinely good experience - great food, pleasant ambience, and decent service. Tasted like a cheap sachet of powdered chocolate mixed with ice Hazelnut Hot Chocolate - Equally terrible, again felt like a cheap satchet of powdered chocolate mixed with hot water. The drinks were especially disappointing - they didn’t taste fresh, rich, or handcrafted in any way. Just artificial and poorly made. The service was ok but the crowd management was chaotic. Based on today’s experience, Casa Fresco no longer lives up to its earlier reputation, and I don’t see myself returning anytime soon.

review_text: Great food, but service needs improvement  The food here is really good — flavours are on point and overall quality is definitely a strong positive. review_text: Visited Casa Fresca today with a group of around 8 people. We ordered quite a lot, and the total bill came to approximately ₹5,000, which felt quite cost-effective for the quantity and quality.  The hazelnut cold coffee and garlic bread really stood out—both were delicious and worth trying. Overall, the food tasted good and the vibe of the place is pleasant, making it a nice spot to hang out with friends.  One downside is the seating space. We had to combine tables, and the service was a bit slow, possibly due to limited staff. That said, the staff were polite and courteous, which made the wait manageable.  There is decent parking available. We were lucky today as there was no waiting time, but usually there tends to be a queue.  Overall, it’s a decent place with good food, a nice ambiance, and reasonable pricing. With better spacing and a bit more staff to improve service speed, the experience could be even better. I would recommend it and would definitely visit again.

review_text: Casa Fresco in HSR Layout is an inviting all-day café renowned for its bright, bungalow-style ambiance and a menu packed with Italian and American favorites. Recently visited for dinner, our group tried the pasta, pizza, burger, pancakes, and the Porky English breakfast. Every dish was satisfying, with the pasta standing out for its rich flavor and excellent texture.​  The ambience is calm and simple, featuring cozy, airy indoor and pleasant outdoor seating, making it a great place for casual evenings. The lighting is soft and the décor unfussy, which adds to the relaxed vibe and comfort, ideal for long conversations or unwinding after a day’s work.​  Service was warm and attentive, contributing to a pleasant dining experience. The menu is diverse, including options like sizzlers, bubble teas, and English breakfast, catering to various tastes and meal times. Food is freshly made, and the cafe is known for using wholesome, quality ingredients which is evident in every bite.​  However, one thing to note is the lack of dedicated parking. Street parking is available, but during busy hours, finding a spot might require some patience. Still, the overall experience more than makes up for this minor inconvenience. If you're looking for a cozy café with great food, Casa Fresco is definitely worth a visit.

review_text: I visited this restaurant about a year ago and had a very bad experience. Unfortunately, when I visited again today, the same thing happened.  I placed an order for a chicken club sandwich at around 7:05 PM. After waiting 20 minutes, the order was still not ready. When I asked the staff about it, they told me it would be ready in 5 minutes. After 10 min, I followed up again, and this time they said it was still not ready and would take another 15 minutes.  At this point, I wasn’t even sure if my order had been placed properly. Despite asking multiple times, the staff made no effort to resolve the issue. The restaurant wasn’t overcrowded either—there were only about 30 people in total—so lack of capacity was not the problem.  The service staff seemed completely indifferent and showed no concern about the delay. Frustrated, I asked for the bill for just the water bottle I had taken. They quickly provided the bill for that, which I paid before leaving.  I will never visit this restaurant again due to such poor service and behavior. A suggestion: even if your food is world-class, customer satisfaction is equally important.

review_text: We were looking forward to a quiet, pet-friendly brunch at Casa Fresco today — but the experience left us quite disappointed.  Today, my family and I (husband, wife, our 2-year-old daughter, and our 5-year-old golden retriever) visited Casa Fresco for a quiet Sunday brunch. Before heading over, we called to confirm if the café was pet-friendly and were told they would be happy to accommodate our dog.  Upon arrival, we took the only available table in a corner to ensure we wouldn’t disturb anyone and could enjoy our meal peacefully. However, a group of four women seated nearby expressed discomfort with our dog’s presence and repeatedly asked us to move him, despite our assurances that he’s well-behaved and remained quietly by our side.  Unfortunately, rather than escalate the situation or let it ruin our morning further, we decided to leave. I had hoped to speak to the manager, but they weren’t available at the time.  As a suggestion to the café’s management: it may help to have a separate seating area for guests who are uncomfortable around pets. This would allow pet owners and non-pet-friendly guests to enjoy their time without conflict or discomfort.  Wishing you continued success and hoping for a more inclusive experience in the future.

review_text: Updated review  01/11 - Went again, gave this place another chance but i have to reduce a star now as out of the 6 items we ordered, 3 were below average , while other 3 were good. Don't think a restaurant can become favourite when their food is hit or miss and the chef literally keeps saying this is how it's made. Staff takes feedback but isn't welcoming at all and can't say if they passed my feedback or not.  So, went yesterday and ordered 2 bubble teas - taiwanese bubble tea and taro bubble tea. Taiwanese was good but taro one literally tasted like vanilla ice cream shake, not even sure if it was real taro roots or purple colour there.  Had verona mushrooms and korean chicken appetizer. Mushrooms one was really good but korean chicken was pretty average.  Also got alfredo pasta and wok and smoke platter. Again pasta was great BUT platter (priced at 380rs) was one of the worst dishes we have ever had - Too much ketchup in this chinese food item and the dish wasnt stir fried as given in description. The sauce was like a gravy, real food didn't match the description and even after getting it replaced once (when the chef didn't change anything), the dish was below average.  Don't think now I want to give this place another try as the expérience can't be 50-50 all the time. If the menu is extensive, all items must be good so pls don't compromise on that and the staff really needs to be more smiling and welcoming.  19/07 - the atmosphere is lovely however service is a little slow and the food (coincidentally both the main course items we ordered) was okayish. We got a cold coffee boba which was good but not cold at all so had to get ice, 2 chicken steak (one fried one and one grilled one). In both the steaks, the sauce was very thick and it literally become a thick paste on pouring it on the chicken so much so that you could taste the thickening agent in the sauce i.e. flour of some kind. The fried chicken was very dry as it wasn't coated with bread crumbs.. chicken breast tends to get dry if overcooked and that's what happened. It was so difficult to even cut it with the knife and chewing took ages.. When i gave this feedback, I was told that the chef says it's like this only so ummm.. okay.. they said they can replace and give the same chicken. They did and it was again the same issue.. The accompaniments with the chicken were good so no complaints there. We also ordered garlic bread which tasted nice. Overall, okayish experience but i would still give 3 stars to them for trying and bcos the ambience is good. Want to go again n try other items to decide further.

review_text: We came on a Sunday morning and the day was just starting for them and practically empty. The outdoor seating had fans and it have a good ambience and comfort. They have an extensive menu that offers an all day dining and the breakfast combos.  We ordered a brioche french toast, scrambled eggs with broccoli and mushroom, an extra bacon , ginger tea and ginger lemon honey tea.  Starting with the good, the scrambled eggs was really delicious. You might have to tell them whether you want it more cooked as by default it comes a bit runny which may not be to everyone's liking. The bread served with the omelette was okay as it felt a bit hard .  The french toast didn't feel like a brioche but normal brown bread and it was also a bit drier than a regular one. The maple syrup served with it solves that issue though. The ginger chai was good.  The most disappointing part was the extra bacon which was very less for the 100 rupees you pay. When asked, they said they weigh 30gms for that price but it didn't feel that to be. It was barely a strip of bacon that they have given and that too overcooked and crispy. That was a huge disappointment.  Also the ginger honey lemon tea , even though I asked to be less sweet was still very sweet for my palate and it was just warm and not hot.  Overall, a very mixed feeling of dining having both excellent and average food.

review_text: Been there. Not too difficult to find out. Great ambiance. Lovely outside seating which I prefer usually with the pleasant weather in Bangalore.  Service - there were literally 3 to 4 waiters both male and female standing near the counter with a clueless face. We ordered some hot water to drink as it was a bit cold outside and my throat was already hurting, but that girl first of all forgot to bring it totally. We waited for 10-15 mins before I called her again and told her which is then they brought it but after delegating it to someone else. Poor management and lack of interest or cluelessness.  The starter that my friend has ordered while waiting for me till I reach, even that wasn't served till I  had reached. It was served 10-15 mins after I reached. And it was just one potato-based starter. Main dish might have come in a timely way mostly as we tried their pizza. Basically the service is very slow and they really need to work on this. Although when going there for a long chit chat, this wouldn't be much of a problem.  Food - The potato-based starter (don't recall the name) was very oily. Had to use tissues at our end to take out the excess oil, the taste was okay okay. The chutney served along with it made it bearable to eat.  The pizza was delicious and hot. I enjoyed having it. It had a thin crust and fresh toppings.  The total cost that we paid for a Tea, one starter and a Pizza was somewhere around 800-850.  Overall a good cafe with overall average food quality for nearby people to hang out either if they've a lot of "time" to spend or won't be bothered with the slow service, as I don't think the cafe owner or the management team would read people's reviews and suggestions and then improve themselves. Haha Highly unlikely. So yeah that's pretty much it.

review_text: Casa Fresco HSR provides a solid dining experience with a focus on fresh, quality ingredients. The restaurant has a casual, inviting atmosphere that is ideal for a relaxed meal with friends or family. The menu features a range of dishes that are both familiar and well-prepared, though the flavors, while good, don’t always stand out as particularly unique. The quality of the ingredients is evident, but the overall culinary experience might not be memorable for those seeking something distinctive.  Service at Casa Fresco is generally attentive and friendly, though it can be a bit slow during peak hours. The staff is knowledgeable and willing to make recommendations, adding a positive touch to the visit.  While Casa Fresco HSR doesn’t necessarily push culinary boundaries, it excels in providing a dependable and enjoyable meal. It’s a good option if you’re in the neighborhood and want a satisfying dining experience without any major surprises. For those looking for a reliable spot with fresh ingredients and a comfortable setting, Casa Fresco is worth considering, though it might not be the first choice for a special or adventurous dining occasion.

The flavors are well-balanced, and it's a satisfying meal that keeps you full for hours.  3. **Florentine Pizza** - The Florentine pizza is a delightful fusion of flavors. Topped with fresh spinach, creamy ricotta, mozzarella, and a hint of garlic, this pizza is both light and flavorful. The crust is perfectly crispy, and the ingredients are fresh and well-balanced.
